intent: Launch a weekly email newsletter about sustainable living, growing to 100 subscribers over 3 months.

nodes.title: Choose email newsletter platform
nodes.description: The user has not yet chosen an email platform. Platform choice affects all downstream steps: account setup, template design, subscriber import, and send configuration. Substack is the recommended starting point.

nodes.title: Set up newsletter account and profile
nodes.description: Create account on chosen platform. Set newsletter name, description, and welcome email for new subscribers. Make sign-up page publicly accessible.
acceptance_criteria: Newsletter name and description are set
assumptions: Platform chosen is Substack or equivalent self-service tool

nodes.title: Invite first subscribers
nodes.description: Reach out to personal contacts via text or email. Share sign-up link on Instagram. Target at least 30 subscribers before sending issue #1.
acceptance_criteria: Sign-up link shared on at least one social channel
assumptions: User has roughly 200 reachable contacts across personal network and Instagram

nodes.title: Write first newsletter issue
nodes.description: Draft the first newsletter issue. Should be personal, explain why the newsletter exists, and introduce the sustainable living topic. Keep it under 500 words to start.
assumptions: User will write the content themselves

nodes.title: Review and approve first email send
nodes.description: The user must personally review issue #1 and approve the send. Sending is public, irreversible, and reaches real subscribers. No agent or automated process may press send.

nodes.title: Establish weekly sending schedule
nodes.description: Milestone: issue #1 sent, weekly cadence established. Track subscriber growth toward 100-subscriber goal over 3 months.
acceptance_criteria: At least 3 consecutive weekly issues sent

assumptions: User will write all newsletter content themselves
Roughly 200 personal contacts are reachable via text, email, or Instagram
unknowns: Exact subscriber count on day of first send

blind_spots.text: No email platform chosen yet — all downstream steps depend on this decision
blind_spots.resolution_hint: Pick a platform (Substack recommended) before anything else

blind_spots.text: User is assumed to be writing solo
No subscriber list exists yet — first send may reach very few people
blind_spots.resolution_hint: Build audience before scheduling issue #1 send

blind_spots.text: Sending the first email to subscribers is a public, irreversible action
blind_spots.resolution_hint: User must personally review and approve before sending

open_questions: Which email platform will you use?
Do you have any collaborators or is this a solo project?

do_not_assume: Whether the user has a subscriber list ready
